shared_elements: horizontal band of zigzag / chevron-triangle pattern running below the upper edge
justification: The only correspondence is a horizontal register of zigzag/hatched-triangle ornament set just below the top edge of each surface, a generic geometric motif. Otherwise B is densely figural, with birds, quadrupeds, a row of arcade-like loops and animals in profile stacked in registers, while A carries no figures at all, only a single incised geometric band on an otherwise plain body.
